**Finding submitted: deviation (Article X(b), ¶p0125).**

- **Direction:** The covenant is one-way and binds *us* (Licensee) only — squarely a customer-side restriction, so it is in scope.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** Term + **three years** post-termination (rule caps at 12 months, walk-away beyond 24) and it covers **any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates**, not just personnel involved in the engagement (also walk-away). Not mutual.
- **What is already acceptable:** "Solicit" is narrowly defined with a general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-out, and there is no no-hire element — so no edits were needed there.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** made the covenant mutual, limited it to personnel directly involved in the performance or receipt of the Agreement, cut the tail to 12 months, and added a 12-months-from-end-of-involvement backstop; the existing carve-out sentence is untouched.
- **Noted, not separately flagged:** the injunctive-relief clause (¶p0126) gives Licensor equitable relief for non-solicitation breaches, which amplifies the over-broad scope — addressed indirectly by narrowing the covenant.
